limits: Assessed all nine supplied rough setups and the three s02 alternate compositions against the seven selected external setups and production calibration. The concept gate is blocked by s02 character-role: its dock composition must make the planned pushing relationship readable. No unresolved REFERENCE_STRUCTURE_GAP or REFERENCE_SCENE_IMITATION was found; the plan preserves meaningful development, semantic resets and justified minimalism. Assessment concerns rough silhouette, scale, hierarchy and represented interaction only. Static alternate states do not establish continuous contact, material transformation, timing, motion, caption rhythm or foreground closure. No MP4 playback, listening, factual verification or finished-art approval is claimed. Production timestamps are unavailable and were not invented.
